name: baton
description: baton v7: a prime orchestrator that never reads, with a run memory and a project memory instead of a growing context

rotateAtPercent.title: Rotate at percent
rotateAtPercent.description: During an active run, compact the prime and wake it from memory once its context reaches this percent of the window

wakeBudgetLines.title: Wake budget (lines)
wakeBudgetLines.description: The most blocks memory_wake prints: recent notes verbatim, older ones collapsed into summaries

memoryDir.title: Project memory directory
memoryDir.description: Where the project memory (spanning runs) lives, relative to the session's project root

approvals.title: Ask before irreversible commands
approvals.description: During a run, git push, gh pr create/merge/close, publishing, reset --hard and rm -r from any agent wait for your approval (claude -p refuses them). BATON_APPROVALS=0 turns both gates off.

phaseGate.title: Check each finished phase
phaseGate.description: When a sub-orchestrator reports DONE, the prime's next dispatch waits until you approve the phase or send it back with a reason (interactive sessions only)

prPollSeconds.title: PR poll interval (seconds)
prPollSeconds.description: During a run with a GitHub goal, how often the mod reads the PR with gh (state, checks, the reviewer's verdict, new comments). At least 30.

tokensPerGoal.title: Token budget per goal
tokensPerGoal.description: Fresh tokens (input + output + cache writes, metered by the mod) a goal may spend before another review or fix round is refused and the operator is asked. 0 turns the budget off.

labels.title: Mirror the goal state as an issue label
labels.description: Keep one baton:<state> label on the goal's issue (queued, planned, building, reviewing, ready, merged, blocked)

boardProject.title: GitHub Projects board number
boardProject.description: Also move the goal's issue across this project's Status column (Todo, In progress, In review, Done, Blocked). 0 leaves boards alone.

boardOwner.title: Board owner
boardOwner.description: The user or organization that owns the board (default: you)

forbiddenFiles.title: More forbidden files
forbiddenFiles.description: Comma-separated globs added to the defaults (.env, .env.*, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa, credentials.json, …): refused at git add, and a merge-ready row on the PR

agentContextWarnPercent.title: Subagent context threshold (%)
agentContextWarnPercent.description: When a subagent's context reaches this percent of its window, the mod messages it once: finish now, or return SPLIT. The prime's threshold is rotateAtPercent.

prices.title: Model prices (JSON)
prices.description: Add or override $ per million tokens, e.g. {"claude-sonnet-5-5": {"input": 3, "output": 15, "cacheRead": 0.3}}. Models without a price show their cost as unknown.
